name: Thread Picture
description: A picture-by-numbers puzzle. Number clues tell you which cells to thread; fill them and a small picture appears. A puzzle each day that remembers your best, or a new one whenever you like.
author: Lullshift

help.summary: A 5 by 5 or 10 by 10 grid with number clues for every row and column. Each number is the length of a run of filled cells, in order. One answer, reached by logic alone.
help.goal: Fill exactly the cells the clues describe. The picture is complete when every row and column matches its clues. There is no timer, and fewer moves is only a bonus.
howToPlay: Read a clue, for example 3 1 means a run of three filled cells, then a gap, then one filled cell.
Fill cells you know belong to the picture. Mark cells you know are empty so you can stop thinking about them.
Work line by line: a clue that nearly fills its line settles many cells at once, and each settled cell helps the crossing lines.
Today's puzzle is the same for everyone today and remembers your best. New puzzle deals a fresh one. Restart clears the board, and Undo takes back your last move. Pick 5 by 5 or 10 by 10 with Size.

controls.action: Use the current tool on the cell (fill or mark)
Fill the cell, or clear it if it is filled
Mark the cell empty, or clear the mark
Mark a cell empty with the pointer
Reach Size, Tool, Undo, Restart and the puzzle buttons

tips: Start with the biggest clues: a 5 in a line of 5, or 4 1 in a line of 6, is settled at once.
Large runs overlap with themselves: a 7 in a line of 10 must fill the middle four cells.
A screen reader reads each cell with its row clue and column clue.
You can stop at any time. Your picture is saved and waits for you.
